latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of context-switcher.
- Supports switching between Work/Focus, Personal, Creative, and Do Not Disturb modes via natural language or calendar events.
- Each mode customizes notification filtering, memory surface, and response style.
- Modes auto-restore to previous context after timer or event end.
- All data and state remain local; no external API calls or credentials needed.
- Easily configure profiles and setup auto-trigger from calendar integration.
